standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: You are not the first to make your way down here. Undoubtedly, you will not be the last.
My aeternal name, given to me long ago, is Jimp.
Yes, though my many centuries upon this realm have taught me that the newer tongues struggle with its pronounciation.
So you may call me Jim.
I see you still have questions. Before I answer them, I will need you to swear to secrecy.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Hang on... why would I do that?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: I believe you will find my cooperation helpful. Perhaps I shall find yours helpful one day too.

options.text: I've already entered one dubious contract.

steps.player: I've already entered one dubious contract.
I'm not sure I should be signing any others.

steps.npc: You will find the nature of my contracts refreshing, then. My terms are simple: do not endanger me or take what is mine, and I shall do what I can to help you.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.text: You sign the crumpled looking document.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: Excellent. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance, [player name].

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Wait, how do you know my name? Was this a trick?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: No, friend, you signed it right here.

steps.npc: I suppose since you already know my name, you are asking who I am in the context of history and society.
I am afraid other agreements bar me from telling you much of my past. Nowadays, I am a humble servant of Yama, existing only to do as he pleases.
Mostly fetching records, and dying. When I am not doing that, I rest here. The features of this isle remind me of those I once knew.
I already skirt as closely as I can to what I am disallowed from sharing. I apologise, but I cannot answer further.
This isle is a small wonder. The rock formations here bear a slight resemblance to those from my own realm.

steps.player: The rock looks like it's crumbling.

steps.npc: Yes, infernal shale is kept together largely by the pressure from above. Once a piece is broken off, it can easily be broken down with a hammer and chisel.

steps.player: That's good to know. What about the smithy?

steps.npc: I can say nothing more than that it was not here when I arrived.
I cannot say.

steps.text: If the player has never received Jim's wet cloth:

steps.npc: Yes, the unique composition of this chasm does create a warm environment.

steps.player: I can see my sweat turning to vapour as soon as it appears.

steps.npc: Yes, water is an ineffective coolant at this temperature. Perhaps I could offer an alternative.

steps.text: Jim hands you a cloth dripping with blackened liquid.

steps.npc: The liquid will only offer a brief respite from the heat, but I find it can help to apply it frequently between bursts of exertion.

steps.player: I see, thanks. I'll give that a try.

steps.npc: I can see you eyeing the liquid. It is best you do not ask.

steps.text: If the player has previously received Jim's wet cloth:

steps.npc: Have another cloth. Remember, it only offers a brief respite from the heat. You'll want to time bursts of exertion right after using it.

options.text: Why is there a smithy down here?

steps.player: Why is there a smithy down here?

steps.npc: I cannot speak to the purpose the smithy has, but I might be able to shed some light on the purposes it could be given.
The furnace is capable of extremely high temperatures. Whilst not very helpful for your ores, it can melt metal from our realm.

steps.player: Like the rocks on this isle?

steps.npc: Not quite, though they are necessary to power the furnace. Nobody but Yama has access to the kinds of ores it was designed for.

steps.player: But if I were to get my hands on some, I could work them here?

steps.npc: Yes. The process is quite involved. Smaller shards must be melted into nuggets for stability, and then combined into chunks.

steps.player: I see. Maybe I can give that a go.

options.text: You're very friendly for a demon.

steps.player: You're very friendly for a demon.

steps.npc: I am not alone in this amongst my kind, but I understand that I am rare. I have my reasons for being this way.

steps.player: Well, if there is anything I can do for you, let me know.

steps.npc: Thank you. There is little I can ask of you given the nature of my other agreements, but watching you work on this isle does bring me some comfort.
Safe travels, [player name].
